options.label: stop-bell
options.description: Terminal bell when the agent finishes a turn. Works everywhere.

options.label: stop-notify-macos
options.description: macOS desktop notification when the agent finishes.

options.label: stop-glass-sound-macos
options.description: Play the Glass sound on macOS when the agent finishes.

options.label: block-env-file-writes
options.description: Block edit/write to .env, secrets, *.pem, and *.key files. Vetoes the call; the model sees the rejection reason.

options.label: block-git-internals
options.description: Block edit/write to anything inside .git/. Use a real git command instead.

options.label: post-edit-prettier
options.description: Auto-format JS/TS/JSON/MD/CSS/HTML files with prettier after edit. Silent no-op if prettier isn't installed.

options.label: audit-tool-calls
options.description: Append every tool call (timestamp / session / tool / ok) to ~/.local/state/kimiflare/tool-audit.log.
